en: A sepia-toned image showing part of a historic coastal city with stone fortifications, a prominent round bastion, and a harbor filled with old wooden sailing ships. The foreground features leaves hanging from a tree, and a stone jetty extends into the water. The architecture in the background includes classical domes and stone buildings. The bottom left contains the printed text 'Dubrovnik (Ragusa)'.
